name: billfold-id-api
description:
# General info

Billfold ID provides access to **[Billfold Wallet API](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/Billfold/billfold-wallet-api/2.0.0)**, **[Billfold Pay API](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/Billfold/billfold-pay-api/1.0.0)** and the **[Billfold Public API](https://qa.rfid.billfoldpos.xyz/specifications/public_api/introduction)**.

**BILLFOLD ID IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR EACH SERVICE INTEGRATION. CLARIFY WITH EVERY SERVICE DEVELOPER IF THE ID SYSTEM WAS ALREADY INTEGRATED OR NOT.**

# How it works


The Billfold ID is the single point of authentication for a few Billfold system components. At the moment they are

- Billfold App API
- Billfold Pay API
- Billfold Public API

## Steps

1. Go to the Billfold ID web interface for the selected env
   - **[https://draft.id.billfold.app](https://draft.id.billfold.app)** - Draft
   - **[https://staging.id.billfold.app](https://staging.id.billfold.app)** - Staging
   - **[https://qa.id.billfold.app](https://qa.id.billfold.app)** - QA
   - **[https://id.billfold.app](https://id.billfold.app)** - Production
2. Register there using your email
3. Ask Airon or Ruslan to make you an Admin
4. Generate the API key and use it to get/check token
5. If you are the client developer
    - Obtain the token by calling `https://id.billfold.app/api/token`
    - Use this token to access the above services
6. If you are the API developer
    - Verify incoming client requests by calling `https://id.billfold.app/api/check-token`
    - Use the result of this verification to allow/deny client access to your service

# API urls list

- `id-api.billfold.app`
- `id-api-staging.id.billfold.app`
- `id-api-draft.id.billfold.app`

You can check the status and the version of an API by this link

```
https://id-api.billfold.app/status
```

# Authentication

You need the api key to authenticate to Billfold ID API. Api key can be obtained at **[https://id.billfold.app](https://id.billfold.app)** - this is the web interface of the Billfold ID. You should add header `"Authorization": "Bearer {apiKey}"` to every request.

# Error handling

The api returns `400 Bad request` if the request is malformed (for example, some parameter is missed), `401 Unauthorized` if token is expired or invallid, `404 Not found` if some object can't be found, `422 Unprocessable Entity` if we the request can't be processed for some reason and `500` in all other cases.
